jobs.title: Strategy & Ops Analyst
jobs.description:
Jeeves is the stablecoin-native banking platform for global enterprises. Thousands of companies across 35 countries run their corporate cards, payments, treasury and spend on one platform, with more than $5B in annualized volume, payouts to 190 countries, and one of the fastest-growing stablecoin payment networks in the world. BMW, H&M, Lululemon, Burger King, Kavak and XP are among them, and more than 80% of customers use multiple Jeeves products.
We chose hard problems on purpose.
We hire for one thing: relentlessness. A strong motor that keeps going when the problem has no playbook. You'll know in your first week if Jeeves is right for you. For the right people, it's the steepest learning curve of your career.
Jeeves has raised more than $400 million in equity funding from Andreessen Horowitz, Y Combinator, CRV, Coinbase Ventures, GIC, AllianceBernstein, CoinFund and others.
If you want to rebuild how money moves across borders, come build it with us.


We're looking for an Strategy & Ops Analyst to join our Operations team in Brazil. This is not a pure execution role: you'll split your time between running the recurring operations and automating those same processes — working hands-on with AI and our internal tooling to redesign how the work gets done.
 
You'll sit close to everything that happens after a client is live. Much of this still runs on manual steps, spreadsheets, and human memory. Your job is to run it reliably — and then to make it so it doesn't need to be run manually again.
 
Priorities shift as the business does (new products, new markets, new partner requirements), so you'll need to connect the dots across multiple workstreams and adapt fast, without compromising the accuracy of the numbers. This role is built for someone early in their career who is organized, curious, and genuinely excited to build with AI tools rather than just use them.
 
Location: This role is based out of São Paulo, Brazil, and is a full-time position where it is required to come into our office at complexo JK Iguatemi (1-2 days/week). #LI-Hybrid

What You'll Do:
-
Run recurring operations processes end to end across billing, banking partners, and client reporting — following documented SOPs, hitting the deadlines, and flagging exceptions early

-
Automate the work itself: build, test, and maintain Claude replacing manual steps, with the goal of eliminating manual work rather than just completing it

-
Monitor daily and weekly operations , triage what's real, resolve what you can, and escalate what you can't

-
Document everything in Notion: keep process pages, exception logs, and trackers current so any process you own is transferable to someone else on day one

-
Bring a process efficiency mindset: identify bottlenecks, propose improvements, and redesign workflows while safeguarding the accuracy and audit trail that financial operations demand

-
Partner with Product, Engineering, Compliance, and Sales to turn recurring manual fixes into permanent product fixes, and to support new launches on the operations side
What We're Looking For
-
Fluent Portuguese and English. Jeeves is a global company and English is the language we use internally between regions. Spanish is a plus.

-
0–2 years of experience. Recent graduates are very welcome — a degree in business, economics, finance, accounting, engineering, or a related field, or an internship in operations, finance, consulting, or fintech

-
Genuine excitement to work with AI tools like Claude every day , and interest in building automations rather than only using them. No prior experience required, but curiosity and willingness to experiment are non-negotiable

-
Strong spreadsheet skills (pivot tables, lookups, building and maintaining recurring files). Comfort with SQL, or a real appetite to learn it quickly — we live in Metabase

-
Strong attention to detail. This work touches client money, invoices, and credit limits; you catch things others miss and take documentation seriously

-
Highly adaptable; you handle shifting priorities and ambiguity well and can switch context across processes, regions, and products without losing rigor

-
Comfort with repetitive, documentation-heavy work, paired with the instinct to systematize and automate it rather than just power through it

-
Clear written communication in both languages, for client-facing and internal correspondence

-
Nice to have: fintech, banking, or startup experience; exposure to Python, SQL, or Apps Script; familiarity with Notion, Slack, HubSpot, or Linear
Why Join Us:
You'll see how a global fintech actually works from the inside — billing, credit, collections, banking partners, compliance, and the product decisions behind all of it. You'll build real financial operations expertise fast, and you'll learn to build AI-powered automations that reshape how an entire team operates.

- Mandatory fluency in English and Spanish, Portuguese is a plus

- Preferable experience in Zendesk Platform /Hubspot

- Advanced communication skills (written and spoken)

- Curious about the details on how the business operates

- Self-starter, proactive and highly motivated

- Team player and very hands on

- Agile and able to pivot quickly with the changing environment

jobs.title: Head of Global Partnerships
jobs.description:
Jeeves is the stablecoin-native banking platform for global enterprises. Thousands of companies across 35 countries run their corporate cards, payments, treasury and spend on one platform, with more than $5B in annualized volume, payouts to 190 countries, and one of the fastest-growing stablecoin payment networks in the world. BMW, H&M, Lululemon, Burger King, Kavak and XP are among them, and more than 80% of customers use multiple Jeeves products.
We chose hard problems on purpose.
We hire for one thing: relentlessness. A strong motor that keeps going when the problem has no playbook. You'll know in your first week if Jeeves is right for you. For the right people, it's the steepest learning curve of your career.
Jeeves has raised more than $400 million in equity funding from Andreessen Horowitz, Y Combinator, CRV, Coinbase Ventures, GIC, AllianceBernstein, CoinFund and others.
If you want to rebuild how money moves across borders, come build it with us.


We are seeking a Head of Global Partnerships to architect, lead, and scale Jeeves' partner ecosystem across our most strategic regions: North America, Latin America (focused on BR, MX, & CO), and EMEA. Reporting directly to the CRO, this leader will own the full partnerships vision — from setting the global framework to closing the deals that matter most.
This is a role for a builder who thinks in ecosystems, not channels. The best partnerships leaders we've seen don't specialize in one type of partner — they've built playbooks for many: stablecoin and crypto networks, banks and financial institutions, brokers, technology platforms, advisory firms, accounting networks, marketplaces, VC/PE ecosystems, embedded finance players, and models we haven't thought of yet. If you've spent your career building one kind of channel, this isn't the right seat. If you've built several — and you understand how they reinforce each other — we want to talk.
You will strengthen our existing broker-driven channels in high-growth markets like Brazil and Mexico while simultaneously pioneering new distribution models across every partnership category relevant to a global fintech. You'll operate as both strategic architect and hands-on dealmaker: setting the long-term vision for a high-impact channel ecosystem responsible for driving a sizable portion of Jeeves revenue, building a world-class partner portfolio, and ensuring successful execution at every stage of the partnership lifecycle.
Location: This role is based out of Mexico City, Mexico, and is a full-time hybrid position where it is required to come into our office in Roma Norte. #LI-HYBRID

What You’ll Do:
- Define & Scale a Multi-Dimensional Partnerships Strategy
Establish the vision, framework, and goals for Jeeves' partner ecosystem — not as a single channel program, but as a true multi-type ecosystem spanning brokers, banks, technology integrations, stablecoin and crypto networks, accounting firms, advisory partnerships, marketplaces, VC/PE relationships, embedded finance players, and beyond. The right candidate will see white space where others see a complete program.

- Expand Broker & Channel Performance
Strengthen and optimize our existing broker channels while creating scalable playbooks for replication across multiple regions and partnership types.

- Pioneer New Partnership Categories
Identify and build net-new categories of partnerships that don't yet exist at Jeeves. The best ideas here may be ones we haven't listed — and we want someone who brings their own perspective on where the highest-leverage opportunities are.

- Lead End-to-End Partner Lifecycle
Drive the entire partnership cycle: sourcing, negotiation, deal structuring, onboarding, activation, and performance management across all partner types and geographies.

- Influence & Inspire Internally
Act as the internal champion for partner-led growth, collaborating across Sales, Marketing, Product, Operations, and Legal to maximize partner impact and embed the partner motion into how Jeeves scales.

- Globalize Best Practices
Establish metrics, incentives, processes, and playbooks that can scale partnerships across multiple regions and partner categories while aligning to Jeeves' global growth agenda.
What We’re Looking For:
- Multi-Type Channel Builder (Required)
You've built more than one kind of partnership program from scratch. We're specifically looking for leaders who have developed genuine expertise across multiple partner categories — think: technology partnerships and financial institution relationships and advisory or broker ecosystems. A career spent optimizing a single channel type is not the right background for this role.

- 10+ Years in Partnerships or BD
Experience in fintech, SaaS, payments, or financial services with a track record of designing and scaling partner ecosystems across multiple regions. International experience required, with deep exposure to North America, Latin America, and/or EMEA.

- Commercial Acumen
Exceptional deal-making, negotiation, and execution skills with a strong record of closing high-impact partnerships across diverse partner profiles.

- Cross-Cultural Expertise
Ability to navigate diverse partner ecosystems across geographies; familiarity with Brazil and LatAm markets is a strong plus.

- Languages
Fluency in English and Portuguese required; Spanish strongly preferred. Additional languages advantageous.

- Strategic Vision + Operational Excellence
Ability to balance global strategy-setting with hands-on execution — you've set the vision and you've also done the work.

- Leadership
Demonstrated ability to build, lead, and inspire high-performing international partnerships teams.
Why This Role Matters
Partnerships are a cornerstone of Jeeves' growth strategy worldwide — and we're at an inflection point where the quality of our ecosystem will define how fast we can scale. As Head of Global Partnerships, you won't just manage existing channels. You'll design the architecture of how Jeeves grows through partners across an increasingly complex and opportunity-rich landscape: from traditional brokers to stablecoin networks to embedded finance to models we're still discovering.
If you've built ecosystems — plural, diverse, and interconnected — this is the opportunity to do it at global scale for one of the most ambitious fintech companies in the world.

jobs.title: Head of Sales, Brazil
jobs.description:
Jeeves is the stablecoin-native banking platform for global enterprises. Thousands of companies across 35 countries run their corporate cards, payments, treasury and spend on one platform, with more than $5B in annualized volume, payouts to 190 countries, and one of the fastest-growing stablecoin payment networks in the world. BMW, H&M, Lululemon, Burger King, Kavak and XP are among them, and more than 80% of customers use multiple Jeeves products.
We chose hard problems on purpose.
We hire for one thing: relentlessness. A strong motor that keeps going when the problem has no playbook. You'll know in your first week if Jeeves is right for you. For the right people, it's the steepest learning curve of your career.
Jeeves has raised more than $400 million in equity funding from Andreessen Horowitz, Y Combinator, CRV, Coinbase Ventures, GIC, AllianceBernstein, CoinFund and others.
If you want to rebuild how money moves across borders, come build it with us.


Jeeves is building the financial operating system for companies across Latin America — and Brazil is our fastest-growing, and most strategic market. We're looking for a Head of Sales to own how we win it.
This is not a seat-warmer role. You'll inherit a team that's already producing, a product that's already winning, and a market where we have more demand than we can currently cover. Your job is to turn that momentum into a dominant commercial machine — one that is unapologetically metrics-driven, methodology-rigorous, and AI-native.
You'll report directly to the Country Manager, Brazil, and partner with global leaders across Marketing, RevOps, Customer Success, and Product to shape how Jeeves goes to market in the region.
 
Location: This role is based out of São Paulo, Brazil, and is a full-time position where it is required to come into our office at complexo JK Iguatemi (3 days/week). #LI-Hybrid

Why this role, why now
Brazil is Jeeves' clearest path to category leadership in LatAm. The AE team is performing, but we're under-covering the opportunity in front of us — you'll get to scale it from a position of strength, not from scratch. We have a strong point of view on how a modern sales org should run: rigorous methodology, clean pipeline data, disciplined forecasting, and AI as a true force multiplier. Your job is to execute that point of view in Brazil and set the bar for the rest of the region.
What you'll do:
- Own the numbers. Set ambitious but credible targets, manage to them relentlessly, and run a data-driven operating cadence — weekly pipeline reviews, forecast calls, QBRs, and performance dashboards that tell the truth.

- Run the methodology. Embed MEDDPICC, SPIN, and Challenger into how the team qualifies, sells, and forecasts. Shorten cycles and lift win rates through discipline, not hustle.

- Hire and develop world-class AEs. Build a team that operates with accountability, learns fast, and wins consistently. Raise the bar with every hire.

- Build an AI-native sales org. We expect every rep to be AI-augmented — using Claude, Gong, Clay, and modern CRM copilots as daily tools, not novelties. You'll set the standard and raise it every quarter.

- Sell alongside your team. Engage directly with strategic prospects and customers. Land and expand with CFOs, founders, and finance leaders — and coach your AEs to do the same.

- Shape GTM. Feed market signal back into Product, Marketing, Pricing, and RevOps. Help decide what we build, how we price it, and how we position it in Brazil.

- Build the operating system. Playbooks, onboarding, scorecards, ramp plans — own the infrastructure that lets the team scale without breaking.
What success looks like in year one
- You've scaled the AE team meaningfully while improving — not sacrificing — productivity per rep.

- MEDDPICC (alongside the best of SPIN and Challenger) is embedded end-to-end: every deal, every forecast call, every QBR. Qualification is non-negotiable.

- Forecast accuracy is consistently within 10% of plan, and pipeline coverage sits at 3–4x of quota.

- The team is demonstrably AI-augmented: reps are faster at prospecting, sharper on calls, and better at multithreading complex deals.

- You've personally closed 3–5 strategic logos and built executive relationships Jeeves will leverage for years.
Minimum Qualifications:
- 8+ years in B2B SaaS sales or business development, with 3+ years leading Account Executive teams.

- Fluent in Portuguese and English (written and verbal), Spanish language proficiency a plus.

- Proven track record of building and leading AE teams that consistently meet or exceed quota in a SaaS or subscription-based business.

- Deep expertise in structured sales methodologies — MEDDPICC, SPIN, Challenger, or similar — and demonstrated ability to embed them into how a team operates day-to-day. You have a point of view on qualification and you enforce it.

- Strong analytical and forecasting muscle. Comfortable in HubSpot, Salesforce, and BI tools; you live in dashboards, not gut feel.

- Hands-on experience using AI tools to drive sales productivity — prospecting, call intelligence, outreach personalization, CRM copilots. You can point to specific tools you've deployed and results you've gotten.

- Demonstrated success negotiating and closing complex, high-impact deals with C-level executives (CFOs, founders, partners).

- Strong executive communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate value to financial decision-makers.
Nice to have:
- Background in high-growth fintech, payments, or financial services.

- Multi-market or cross-border commercial experience within LatAm.

- Operating experience in fast-scaling or early-stage companies.

- A network of transferable B2B relationships with mid-market and enterprise companies in Brazil (helpful, not required).

- Track record of building sales playbooks, onboarding programs, and scalable processes from the ground up.
Why Jeeves
We're building the financial OS that LatAm companies have been waiting for, at the speed and ambition of a company that plans to win. If you want to own how a category-defining fintech wins Brazil — with modern tools, a serious methodology, and a team that expects excellence — we'd love to talk.

- Treasury & Cash Management: Monitor cash balances and liquidity across multiple bank accounts and countries.

- Financial Analysis: Maintain cash flow and funding models, analyze variances, and support financial planning.

- Payments & Banking: Support cross-border payments, reconciliations, and relationships with banks and payment providers.

- Data & Automation: Maintain accurate financial data and automate recurring reporting and operational processes.

- Compliance & Controls: Support regulatory requirements, audits, and financial controls in partnership with Compliance and Legal.

- Process Improvement: Identify opportunities to improve processes, controls, and operational efficiency.
What We’re Looking For
- 2–4 years of experience in financial operations, treasury, banking, payments, or fintech.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

- Experience with cash management, financial modeling, or multi-bank environments.

- Advanced Excel skills; experience with automation or data tools is a plus.

- Strong English communication skills, written and verbal.

- Comfortable working in a fast-paced, cross-border environment.

- Experience with banks, payment providers, or regulated financial institutions is a plus.

What You’ll Do:
-
Build & Own the Referral Partner Channel. Identify, recruit, and activate accounting firms, advisory firms, legal/tax firms, and similar professional-services networks as revenue-share referral partners driving new business into Jeeves' top of funnel across Brazil.

-
Activate Your Existing Network. Bring relationships you've already built across the accounting, advisory, and legal community in Brazil and convert them into signed, producing referral partners quickly.

-
Structure & Negotiate Rev-Share Agreements. Design and close referral and revenue-share partnership agreements that align incentives for both sides and consistently generate qualified pipeline.

-
Manage the Full Partner Lifecycle. Own sourcing, onboarding, enablement, and ongoing performance management for every referral partner — including training partners on Jeeves' value proposition and building simple, repeatable referral processes.

-
Drive Pipeline & Revenue Impact. Own targets tied to partner-sourced pipeline and closed revenue, and report regularly on partner performance and overall channel health.

-
Expand Into Adjacent Channels. Once the core referral motion is proven, explore and pilot adjacent partner categories — other professional-services networks, regional intermediaries, or technology integrators — to grow the ecosystem beyond its initial scope.

-
Collaborate Cross-Functionally. Work closely with Sales, Marketing, Legal, and Operations to ensure a smooth handoff of partner-sourced leads and a strong partner experience end to end.

-
Represent Jeeves Locally. Serve as Jeeves' face to the professional-services community in Brazil — attending events, building brand presence, and staying close to market and competitive dynamics.
What We’re Looking For:
-
Existing Relationships (Required). You already have deep, active relationships with accounting firms, advisory firms, and/or legal firms in Brazil. This is the single most important qualification — we need someone who can activate a channel quickly, not build one from a cold start.

-
5+ Years in Business Development, Partnerships, or Channel Sales. A track record of building and scaling referral or channel partnerships, ideally within fintech, financial services, professional services, or B2B SaaS.

-
Deal-Making Skills. Comfortable structuring and negotiating revenue-share and referral agreements, and closing partner deals independently.

-
Local Market Fluency. Deep understanding of the accounting, advisory, and legal professional-services landscape in Brazil, including how referral relationships are typically structured and incentivized.

-
Self-Starter. Able to operate autonomously in a newly created role — building process, materials, and playbooks as you go, with minimal hand-holding.

-
Languages. Fluency  in English is required, Spanish is a plus.

-
Growth Mindset. Interest in growing this role over time, potentially into broader regional or global partnerships leadership as Jeeves' partner ecosystem scales.
Why This Role Matters
Referral relationships with trusted accounting, advisory, and legal firms are one of the most efficient ways to reach the business owners who need Jeeves — and Brazil are two of our highest-growth markets for exactly that motion. This role is our first dedicated, in-country investment in that channel.
You'll build the initial playbook, prove the model, and have a real opportunity to expand it into new partner categories and geographies as Jeeves scales its broader partnerships function — with a credible path to grow alongside it.
